# doxastic claim

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:doxasticClaim`](gmeow-doxasticClaim.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/doxasticClaim>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) that carries the qualitative belief value ([`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md)) for a [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md). Reuses the existing standpoint vocabulary without domain-clashing [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) (whose domain is [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)) onto [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)). The claim's vantage is the believing agent, its [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) is the proposition, and its [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) is the qualitative value (unequivocal, probable, conceivable, refuted, bullshit).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) -> [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:doxasticClaim`](gmeow-doxasticClaim.md) from [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) to [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original belief (high credence, unequivocal) -----------------------------
ex:originalBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: the printer is broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.92"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:originalClaim .

# --- Revised belief (lower credence, probable) --------------------------------
ex:revisedBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: printer may be broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.35"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:revisedClaim .
```

### Flagship Epistemic Ledger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/flagship/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original credence-weighted belief (operator) --------------------------------
ex:opBeliefOriginal a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: LLM recalled the meeting date correctly"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimOriginal ;
    gmeow:credence "0.85"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:justifiedBy ex:evidenceSpan1 .

# --- Revised belief after a defeater ---------------------------------------------
ex:opBeliefRevised a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: LLM probably misremembered the meeting date"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimRevised ;
    gmeow:credence "0.30"^^xsd:decimal .
```

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md), [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the reified doxastic state needs a qualitative standpoint modality; the linked [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) carries [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) directly on a [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md) — its domain is [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md); use this bridge instead.

### How to use

- Set exactly once per [`DoxasticState`](../classes/gmeow-DoxasticState.md), pointing to a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) whose vantage and [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) match the doxastic state's agent and proposition.

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound [`gmeow:doxasticClaim`](gmeow-doxasticClaim.md) ex:aliceRoundClaim. ex:aliceRoundClaim a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md); [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) ex:alice; [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) ex:earthIsRound; [`gmeow:claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) [`gmeow:unequivocal`](../individuals/gmeow-unequivocal.md).
